test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 18 Jul 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word.**

He brought __disgrace__ to his family by being involved in illegal activities.
solution: The correct answer is: **Honour** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The given word '**disgrace**' means a loss of reputation or respect. (प्रतिष्ठा या सम्मान की हानि) • **For example**: *His behaviour at the event brought disgrace to his family's reputation.* • The antonym of 'disgrace' would be a word that means respect or honour. • So, **Honour **is the correct antonym as it means high respect or esteem. (उच्च आदर) • **For example**: *She was awarded a medal in honour of her outstanding achievements.* Therefore, the correct answer is **option 4**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** • **Suspicion **means a feeling of doubt or mistrust. (संदेह या अविश्वास की भावना) • **Shame **means a painful feeling of humiliation or distress caused by the consciousness of wrong or foolish behaviour. (गलत या मूर्खतापूर्ण व्यवहार की चेतना के कारण होने वाली अपमान या परेशानी की दर्दनाक भावना) • **Discord **means disagreement or lack of harmony between people or things. (लोगों या चीज़ों के बीच असहमति या सामंजस्य की कमी) 1be:Tb9c, The correct answer is: **Convergence **
